name: atlas-workspace
description: Atlas, the developer platform for everyone: Rust workspace, Atlas Desktop (Tauri + SvelteKit) and the website

scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace --locked && cargo test --workspace --locked --doc && cargo deny check && scripts/check-skills.sh && scripts/lint-workflows.sh && bun run desktop:check && bun run release:test
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --all && cd apps/desktop && bun run format
scripts.deps:update: for d in . apps/desktop site studio; do (cd $d && bunx npm-check-updates -u --configFilePath "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)") || exit 1; done && bun install && (cd apps/desktop && bun install) && (cd site && bun install)
scripts.desktop:dev: scripts/setup.sh --quiet && cd crates/atlas-desktop && cargo tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: scripts/setup.sh --quiet && cd crates/atlas-desktop && cargo tauri build --ci
scripts.desktop:build:app: scripts/setup.sh --quiet && cd crates/atlas-desktop && cargo tauri build --debug --bundles app --ci
scripts.desktop:check: cd apps/desktop && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
scripts.site:dev: cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run dev
scripts.site:build: cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.site:check: cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
scripts.release:test: bun test scripts && python3 -m unittest scripts/test_generate_manifest.py && scripts/test-bootstrap-channel.sh && scripts/test-labels.sh
